weeks.title: Week 1 – A New Start: a new home, a new city, a new routine
weeks.why_md: Everyone knows what it feels like to start again somewhere new. We follow **Nam** in his first days in Manchester – his flat, his neighbour, the café on the corner, his first day at work. **One world, the same people and words all week**, so the English gets easier every lesson.
goals: Hear the small squeezed words in natural speech: *I'm, you'll, it's, I'd*
Follow a story about a new home and a daily routine without translating
See where an idea turns: *although, however, yet, rather, unless*
Use *be used to + V-ing* and *it takes + time* when you read and hear them
weeks.how_md: Follow **Today** – it tells you what to do and when. Missed a day? No stress: the lesson moves to the next day, and I keep each day to **two lessons at most**. Each lesson is submitted separately, I grade it, and I adjust the next ones.

weeks.title: Week 2 – Food & Eating Out
weeks.why_md: Food is in every conversation. Ordering, recipes, food habits, and Nam's first dinner with new friends.
goals: Understand menus, ordering and small talk at a restaurant
Describe taste and texture words when you hear them

weeks.title: Week 3 – Mind & Feelings
weeks.why_md: Psychology – one of your interests. Stress, habits, sleep and motivation, in everyday English.
goals: Follow a 6-minute psychology podcast with the transcript
Track cause → effect words: because of, so, as a result

weeks.title: Week 4 – Tech in Everyday Life
weeks.why_md: Your favourite topic, but in general English – phones, AI at home, online life. Not technical IT English yet.
goals: Read a news-style article about technology
Follow opinions: I'd argue that…, on the other hand…
Understand a podcast discussion with two speakers
